messages:
Alex: Quick sync — thinking we should tweak the weekly triage cadence. Can we try a shorter 30m slot at 11:15am on Tuesdays instead of the full 45m at 11am? Proposed agenda:

```
- 5m quick status (owner updates)
- 10m bug handoff + assign owners (light triage)
- 10m RFC/design quick reviews (flag blockers)
- 5m action items + follow-ups
```

If people prefer, we can alternate every other week: deep triage (45m) vs light cadence (30m). Thoughts? @Mira would you lead RFC section next week?

Mira: I'm ok with 30m if we keep the deep triage every other week. I can run the RFC slot next week. I have one 10min deep-dive I want to surface: caching behavior on the kv-cache PR.

Samir: prefer 11:00 still — my calendar is packed at 11:15 due to daily stand. Also worried 30m will feel rushed for the bug queue. Can we do 11:00-11:30 and alternate deep weeks?

Kai: alternating weeks sounds sensible. If we keep 11:30 then i'm out on some days. +1 for 11:00-11:30.

Liz: I can own the bug owner assignment rota if we make a short template. I pushed a tiny doc at https://redwood.company/docs/bug-ownership — we can use this as the canonical checklist.

Alex: good call — Samir/Kai preference wins: let's aim for 11:00-11:30 on Tuesdays. Alternate weeks: Week A = light (30m), Week B = deep (45m, extend if needed). Liz — can you drop a one-paragraph template into the doc tonight? I'll update the calendar invite.

Liz: yep will add template by EOD. Template will include fields: bug id, owner, priority, ETA, blocking PR.

OpsBot: Calendar invite updated: "Eng Triage (11:00 - 11:30 Tue) — alternating deep weeks". Reminder set 10 minutes prior. :calendar:

Samir: thanks. One small ask — can we put a short pin in the meeting thread with the top 5 priority bugs before the call? saves time during the slot.

Mira: agree. I'll start a pinned message with 5 highest-impact items 30m before the meeting each week.

Alex: perfect. We'll run this for two cycles and re-evaluate. If anyone has a recurring conflict, DM me and i'll rotate owners. :thumbsup:
